content.title: Experts adjust UCLA vs. UCF prediction after critical Donovan Dent update
content.text: UCLA Bruins guard Donovan Dent's status has been confirmed for the NCAA Tournament First Round game against the Knights. AP By Mac Douglass | Special Correspondent The UCLA Bruins will take on the UCF Knights in the First Round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament at Xfinity Mobile Arena on Friday, scheduled to commence at 7:25 p.m. ET. All week, questions about the status of UCLA’s star transfer point guard Donovan Dent have dominated Bruins-Knights discourse. Dent exited the Big Ten Tournament semifinal against Purdue in the closing minutes of the first half with a minor calf strain and did not return to the game as a precaution. However, it has now been confirmed that Donovan Dent will play on Friday against UCF , with the guard recently stating he feels “100%” heading into the opening round.
